args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), which caused the nightly build to fail (`tests/test_money.py`).
- Switched the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI passed on branch `fix-bankers-rounding` (run ci-0001, sha 08d3cd5986), including `tests/test_money.py`.
